pretreatments.description: Mechanical grinding of grass waste to a particle size of less than 1 mm using a hammer mill and sieving through a 32–42 mesh to select particles of 0.354–0.5 mm.

Ozone pretreatment: grass particles (adjusted for moisture 90% w/w) placed in an enclosed stainless steel reactor with 1 cm bed height and operated in semi-continuous mode under 5.3% ozone concentration at a flow rate of 2000 ml/min for 10 min, with an ozone dose of 0.79 g O3/g TS.
Soaking aqueous ammonia (SAA) pretreatment: soaking grass waste particles in 28–30% (w/w) ammonium hydroxide solution with a solid to liquid ratio of 2:10 at 50 °C for 24 h without agitation.
Size reduction: milling and sieving grass waste particles through a 42 mesh Tyler Standard Screen Scale to obtain particles with a size less than 0.354 mm.
